title: Get Yourself Optimized (Stephan Spencer) — 'How to Be Incorruptible with Eric Ries'
summary: Stephan Spencer releases a second Eric episode on his Get Yourself Optimized show (following the Marketing Speak episode) — walking through why Costco and Patagonia stay true to their mission for decades while so many others give in to shareholder primacy.
blockquote: Most companies eventually give in to the pressure to maximize profit at any cost, but a rare few resist that pull entirely and stay true to their mission for decades.
